name: Metromile
description: Metromile is a pay-per-mile auto insurance platform powered by telematics and data science. Customers attach the Pulse OBD device to their vehicle to track mileage; premiums consist of a base monthly rate plus a per-mile charge. Metromile Enterprise offers a cloud-based REST API platform for property and casualty insurers covering touchless claims automation, accident reconstruction, fraud detection, digital FNOL reporting, and back-office workflow automation. Acquired by Lemonade in July 2022.

offers.description: Pay-per-mile auto insurance with a base monthly rate plus a per-mile charge tracked via the Metromile Pulse OBD device.
